display_name_zh: 突变事件—CRISPR基因依赖双向分析

anchor_selection_contract.cohort_rule: Intersect each event source independently with Model, CRISPRGeneEffect, and CRISPRGeneDependency by ModelID.

event_states.Damaging: value > 0 is mutant; explicit 0 is wild type; missing is excluded
event_states.Hotspot: value > 0 is mutant; explicit 0 is wild type; missing is excluded
event_states.AnySelected: a retained model-gene record is observed; use for landscape only
event_states.ProteinChange: build an allele-specific event from HugoSymbol plus ProteinChange on demand

priority_rules.dual_role: retain Damaging and Hotspot as separate events
priority_rules.unclassified: retain with an explicit unclassified annotation

anchor_selection_contract.common_essential: Retain and flag mutation anchors; use filtering or down-weighting on the dependency-target side as sensitivity analysis.
anchor_selection_contract.druggability: Do not remove a mutation anchor because it is druggable.
anchor_selection_contract.interpretation: Passing the anchor filter means analyzable sample support, not a significant dependency association.

all_mutation_gene_annotations.coverage: all mutation genes with at least one retained record among CRISPR Gene Dependency models

tm00_reference_scripts.role: immutable historical reference; not the default execution entrypoint

mutation_to_target.meaning: fix one mutation event and rank retained dependency targets

target_to_mutation.meaning: fix one dependency target and rank retained mutation events

pair.meaning: return retained evidence for one directed mutation-target pair

semantic_aliases.patient_in_depmap_context: When a user says patients while asking a DepMap mutation-dependency question, interpret this as the corresponding DepMap cell-line cohort and state that mapping; use clinical cohorts only when TCGA, survival, clinical response, or patient-level data are explicitly requested.
semantic_aliases.generic_tsg_mutation: Default to Damaging for a tumor suppressor; report Hotspot separately only when explicitly requested or retained as a mechanism-review event.
semantic_aliases.generic_oncogene_mutation: Default to Hotspot for an oncogene; report Damaging separately only when explicitly requested or retained as a mechanism-review event.

ambiguity_rules.hotspot_gene: Distinguish a Hotspot mutation event from a user-selected dependency target gene.
ambiguity_rules.mutation_without_event_definition: Report available Damaging, Hotspot, and AnySelected counts before choosing a functional event.
ambiguity_rules.direction_without_roles: Identify which entity is the mutation event and which is the CRISPR dependency target.

metric_rules.primary: CRISPRGeneEffect (Chronos continuous score); negative mutant-minus-matrix-negative difference means mutant models are more dependent.
metric_rules.secondary: CRISPRGeneDependency probability; probability >0.5 defines a dependent model and is used for dependent fractions and odds ratio.
metric_rules.legacy_probability_analysis: Historical probability-as-continuous analyses remain traceable but are not the default answer.

statistical_contract.method_source: DepMap Context Explorer public implementation, adapted from lineage/subtype in-group versus out-group to mutation-positive versus mutation-matrix-negative within lineage.

event_state.unknown: missing event value is excluded and must not be converted to wild type

statistical_contract.complete_cases: For every anchor-target pair, exclude missing event or Gene Effect values; require at least 5 non-missing models in each group.
statistical_contract.target_prefilter: Test genes dependent (CRISPRGeneDependency >0.5) in at least 3 and at most 95% of profiled CRISPR models. The portal additionally rescues internal strongly-selective genes when its TDA annotation is available.
statistical_contract.effect: mean CRISPR Gene Effect in mutation-positive complete cases minus mean in matrix-negative complete cases
statistical_contract.test: Two-sided pooled-variance independent t-test, equivalent to scipy.stats.ttest_ind(equal_var=True), matching the current public Context Explorer implementation.

multiple_testing.mutation_to_target: Benjamini-Hochberg across eligible dependency targets for the fixed mutation anchor; this is the primary official-style FDR.
multiple_testing.target_to_mutation: Benjamini-Hochberg across tested mutation anchors for the fixed dependency target, retained as a reverse-query sensitivity field.
multiple_testing.lineage: Correct each lineage and query family separately.

statistical_contract.pan_cancer_confounding: Report within-lineage results or a lineage-adjusted model in addition to unadjusted pan-cancer comparisons.
statistical_contract.legacy_score: Scores from scripts 09-11 and the probability-continuous v1 results are exploratory historical outputs, not the primary significance result.

interpretation: The two directions are row and column queries of one directed mutation-event by dependency-target association matrix. Results are observational candidates, not causal or experimentally validated synthetic lethality.
